1. Item indicator
   * unordered
   1. ordered (in sequential projects)
1. (optional) checkbox
   * [ ] unchecked
   * [x] checked
1. (optional) priority indicator
   * \#flag
   * 🚩
1. **Task name in bold**
1. (optional) command tag
   * \#project & (name | block_id)
   * \#next
   * \#someday
   * \#note
   * \#delete
   * \#inbox
1. (optional) hard break, 1 or more tags
1. (optional) hard break, task's multiline description
1. (optional) hard break, block identifier
   * autogenerated short ^uuid
   * manual ^human-readable

## Examples

* [ ] \#command #flag **Task**  
  \#tag-1  
  Description
  ^uuid

1. [x] **Task**  #project project name  
   \#tag-1 #tag-2  
   ^manual-link

* 🚩 **Task**  #project project name  
  Description  
  ^uuid
* [ ] one-line task sketch
